chime: a cheerful two-tone electronic convenience store door chime, clean, no door noise
store_hum: quiet late-night convenience store ambience, fluorescent light hum and a soft refrigerator compressor drone, no people, no music
scan_beep: a single short barcode scanner beep at a store checkout, clean
mags_blip: friendly electronic notification blip from a ceiling speaker, two soft rising tones
sip: one long loud slurp of hot coffee from a mug, close
flip: a mechanical split-flap display flipping one card with a crisp clack
whoosh: a quick soft cartoon whoosh swish
sizzle: a tiny star slamming onto a counter: a bright electric zap and a hot sizzling crackle, short
ignite: a small whoosh of hair catching fire, a little crackling flame, cartoon, short
pat: quick hands patting out a small fire on someone's hair, three soft pats and a fizzle
fall: a heavy object falling fast from above, descending cartoon whistle, short
thud: a huge heavy stone ball slamming onto a wooden shop counter: deep thud, wood cracking, small objects rattling
orbit: a soft low cosmic gravity hum with gentle whooshes of small objects circling around, subtle, loopable
